title: Extreme (adjective)

description: extreme 可以表示非常嚴重、強度極高、影響深遠、大幅劇烈、過度、急性嚴重、深刻，或根本徹底。不同替代表達的核心差別，是『severity / intensity / reach / scale of change / excess / urgency / depth / fundamental change』。

words.note: 當 extreme 指程度很嚴重、後果很大或情況很惡劣時，severe 很自然。常見於 weather, pain, damage, shortage, punishment。
words.example: The region experienced severe flooding after days of rain.
words.exampleZh: 連日大雨後，該地區出現嚴重水浸。

exercises.original: The area suffered extreme damage during the storm.
exercises.zh: 風暴期間，該區受到嚴重破壞。
exercises.upgrade: The area suffered severe damage during the storm.

options.explanation: severe = 嚴重的。句子顯示「damage is being judged by seriousness and harmful extent」，重點是 seriousness / harmful degree，而不是單純強度或深遠影響。
intense：強烈，偏力道、感覺、熱力、壓力或競爭強度。 本句關鍵是「damage is being judged by seriousness and harmful extent」。因此它要麼把重點放在強度、危害、影響範圍、急迫性、深度或根本改變的另一層意思，要麼詞性／構詞不合，沒有正確答案精準。
drastic：劇烈、大幅，常形容 changes/cuts/measures。 本句關鍵是「damage is being judged by seriousness and harmful extent」。因此它要麼把重點放在強度、危害、影響範圍、急迫性、深度或根本改變的另一層意思，要麼詞性／構詞不合，沒有正確答案精準。

exercises.zh: 醫生警告病人的感染情況十分嚴重。
exercises.upgrade: Doctors warned that the patient had a severe infection.

words.example: The athletes trained under intense pressure.
words.exampleZh: 運動員在極大壓力下訓練。

exercises.zh: 最後一輪的競爭變得非常激烈。

words.meaning: 影響深遠的；波及廣泛的
words.note: 當 extreme 的實際意思是影響範圍非常廣、後果延伸很遠時，far-reaching 很合適。它不是一般強度詞，而是 effect / consequence 詞。
words.example: The policy could have far-reaching consequences for public services.
words.exampleZh: 這項政策可能對公共服務造成深遠影響。

exercises.original: The reform may have extreme consequences for future generations.
exercises.zh: 這項改革可能對後代造成深遠後果。
exercises.upgrade: The reform may have far-reaching consequences for future generations.

words.exampleZh: 公司推出大幅削減成本的措施。
